_comment: Stage A generator roster, called via OpenRouter. Edit slugs/roles here as OpenRouter's catalog shifts — the script reads this file, no code changes needed. Verify current slugs against https://openrouter.ai/models before running at volume.

stage_a_generators.notes: Strong documented Russian coverage, low cost
European lab, different training lineage than Qwen/DeepSeek, strong multilingual benchmarks
Independently benchmarked as a translation-quality leader among commercial engines; swap in a newer Gemini Flash tier as it becomes available
Small model fine-tuned specifically for EN<->RU translation; grounds the ensemble in translation accuracy

stage_c_coverage_model.notes: 1M context, cheap — used periodically to scan the accumulating dataset for redundancy/category gaps. Swap to a larger-context model (e.g. x-ai/grok-4-fast-reasoning) if the dataset outgrows this.
